question: Who won the Pune FIDE Women’s Grand Prix?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Koneru Humpy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Chess Grandmaster Koneru Humpy wins Pune FIDE Women’s Grand Prix.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Indian Grandmaster **Koneru Humpy** won the **Pune FIDE Women’s Grand Prix** with **7/9 points**.

 
 
• 
 
She beat **Nurgyul Salimova** (Bulgaria) in the final round using the **White pieces**.

 
 
• 
 
**Zhu Jiner** (China) also scored **7/9** by beating **Polina Shuvalova** (Russia) with **Black pieces**.

 
 
• 
 
**Tiebreaks** placed Humpy **1st** and Zhu **2nd**, but **both share points and prize money**.

 
 
• 
 
**Divya Deshmukh** (India) drew her final game and finished **3rd.**
